data.title: Kazakhstan Plans Tokenized Government Bond Issuance in Q1 2027
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, Kazakhstan’s central bank plans to work with the Ministry of Finance to issue tokenized government bonds in Q1 2027. Kazakhstan has previously sold about $22.3 million in tokenized central bank bills.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Peter Mattis: China’s Intelligence Can Target Tech Through Business and Personal Ties
data.description: Former CIA counterintelligence analyst Peter Mattis said China’s Ministry of State Security can use business and personal relationships to gather intelligence and potentially influence decisions in strategically important industries, Bloomberg reported. Mattis said technology executives can be targets even without access to classified information, and that AI is expanding Chinese intelligence capabilities.

data.title: Jiang Zhuoer Opens 200% Hedge Short at $65,720, Says Overall Position Is Flat
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, Lebit Mining Pool founder Jiang Zhuoer said he opened a hedge short equal to 200% of his position at a Bitcoin price of $65,720, citing weak market performance. He plans to exit and wait, and would close the short at its entry price if Bitcoin rises back to that level. Jiang said the short hedges his 100% ETH spot position and 100% BTC long position. Excluding small-cap DeFi tokens, his overall position is now equivalent to being flat.

data.title: Solana Labs Launches Leap App for 24/7 Trading in Tokenized Stocks and Other Assets
data.description: Solana Labs has launched Leap, a trading app supporting 24/7 trading in tokenized stocks, ETFs, commodities, currencies and cryptocurrencies. According to Odaily, Solana said in a post on X that Leap General Manager Chris Osborn (@aliquotchris) will attend Breakpoint.

data.title: Paraguay Scandal and Corruption Charges Test Its Safe-Haven Appeal
data.description: Paraguay’s president has fallen, its central bank is in disarray and a financial firm is in ruins, prompting investors to question whether the country remains a good bet, according to Bloomberg. The country had attracted investors in recent years with strong growth, low taxes and a safe-haven reputation in a volatile region.

data.title: STOCKS | Musk’s Tesla Merger Pitch Revives SpaceX’s S&P 500 Bid
data.description: Elon Musk has pitched merging SpaceX with Tesla Inc. as a possible route for SpaceX to join the S&P 500 Index, months after SpaceX was denied swift entry, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Elon Musk Again Praises Jensen Huang, Saying Nvidia Would Have Fewer Deals Without Him
data.description: Elon Musk said Jensen Huang has done an excellent job managing Nvidia’s supply chain. According to Odaily, Musk said many partnership deals were reached with Huang through a handshake rather than a formal written contract, and that at least some key deals might have been lost without him.

data.title: Heating Oil Prices Rise 59% From Last Winter; Maine Nonprofit Says Spike Is Crushing Residents
data.description: According to CNBC, the national average price of heating oil reached about $5.91 a gallon as of Nov. 9, up $2.19, or 59%, from a year earlier. In Maine, the average was about $5.83 a gallon, up $2.49, or 75%; about half of the state’s homes use the fuel. Jason Parent, CEO of AVEC Community Action, said the price jump was putting households under severe strain, with some facing empty fuel tanks or relying on unsafe heating sources. The U.S. Energy Information Administration forecast that households using heating oil would spend an average of $2,115 from November through March, about 21% more than last year. The Trump administration said it would release 300,000 barrels from the Northeast Home Heating Oil Reserve.

data.title: Crypto Liquidations Hit $186 Million in One Hour, Including $60.9795 Million in ETH
data.description: Crypto liquidations totaled $186 million in the past hour, including $60.9795 million in ETH liquidations. According to Odaily, citing Coinglass data, long positions accounted for $181 million and short positions for $5.4592 million. BTC liquidations totaled $54.6108 million.

data.title: Boston Fed President Susan M. Collins: Good Reasons to Hold Rates Steady at October FOMC Meeting
data.description: According to Jin10, Boston Fed President Susan M. Collins said there were good reasons to keep interest rates unchanged at the October FOMC meeting.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Bessent and Lutnick Reportedly Differ on Nvidia Chip Curbs for China
data.description: Bloomberg reported that Axios AI policy reporter Maria Curi described tensions in the Trump administration over efforts to restrict advanced Nvidia chips from reaching China and scrutiny of Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick’s handling of Megaspeed. Curi discussed reported disagreements between Lutnick and other senior officials, including Scott Bessent, and national security questions surrounding US technology exports to China.

data.title: Kava Pauses Axelar Cross-Chain Bridge
data.description: Kava has paused the Axelar cross-chain bridge as a precaution. According to Odaily, Kava said it would share a full incident report as soon as it is ready.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Trump’s China Visit to Include Talks With Xi and Putin
data.description: US President Donald Trump is heading to China for talks with Xi and Putin, according to Bloomberg. Bloomberg White House correspondent Jeff Mason told Bloomberg This Weekend hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini about the administration’s response to a nationwide FAA ground stop and Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy’s push for $50 billion to modernize the US air traffic control system. Mason also looked ahead to Trump’s Asia trip and a planned meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping, with technology and AI in focus.

data.title: Bank of America: These Stocks Have Upside Potential in an Uncertain Market
data.description: According to CNBC, Bank of America analysts identified AT&T, U.S. Bancorp, Krispy Kreme, Madison Square Garden Entertainment and L3Harris Technologies as buy-rated stocks with upside potential amid market uncertainty. The bank reiterated its Buy rating on AT&T and a $34 price objective after better-than-forecast 3Q26 results. Analyst Sara Senatore said Krispy Kreme maintained its F26 adjusted EBITDA guidance despite higher edible oil and fuel costs; the stock is up 20% this month. Madison Square Garden Entertainment shares have risen 48% this year, and the company has 231 Christmas Spectacular shows planned, versus 215 last year, with advance ticket revenue pacing ahead. Bank of America analyst Ronald Epstein said L3Harris Technologies’ new CEO identified priorities including improving execution, growing international business, which accounts for 24% of revenue, and avoiding transformational M&A. The bank also expects U.S. Bancorp to outperform, citing expected double-digit EPS growth supported by fixed-asset repricing and diversified fee revenue.

data.title: AI | Couples Turn to Chatbots for Advice and Mediation During Arguments
data.description:
People are increasingly using AI chatbots for advice, validation and mediation during arguments with their partners, Bloomberg Weekend senior writer Morgan Meaker said on Bloomberg This Weekend, according to Bloomberg.

Meaker said AI can improve communication, but introducing a digital “third entity” into a relationship risks creating distance between couples.

data.title: Glassnode: Stablecoin Supply Falls $17B in a Month, Biggest Drop Since 2022
data.description: According to ChainCatcher citing Glassnode, stablecoin supply contracted by $17 billion over the past month, its largest monthly decline since 2022. Glassnode said holders are converting stablecoins into fiat, reducing purchasing power available to Bitcoin and other crypto markets. The firm added that a bull market requires capital to flow into the ecosystem rather than out of it.

data.title: Russia’s Statistics Service Still Faces Data Disruptions Two Weeks After Cyberattack
data.description: Russia’s statistics service remains unable to fully publish and collect some of its main economic data two weeks after a cyberattack knocked parts of its infrastructure offline, according to Bloomberg. Officials who rely on the figures lack some of their basic tools.

data.title: Hyperliquid Trader Nets About $2.88 Million on Three Closed Trades, Holds $2.58 Million ZEC Short With $1.21 Million Unrealized Profit
data.description:
A Hyperliquid trader has made about $2.88 million from three consecutive closed trades and still holds a $2.58 million ZEC short position with $1.21 million in unrealized profit.

According to Odaily, the closed trades earned $652,100 from ZEC, $36,500 from UNI and $2.19 million from PONS.
